page.content:
Emperor Audrii II (d. 1027) was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 995–1027 AG), succeeding his cousin Wallach II as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. As a cousin of Wallach, Audrii was a grandson of Elrood III.

page.overview:
Who is Audrii II?

Emperor Audrii II (d. 1027) was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 995–1027 AG), succeeding his cousin Wallach II as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. As a cousin of Wallach, Audrii was a grandson of Elrood III.

In 1027, there was a rupture with the Sardaukar forces. The Sardaukar Bashar usurped the throne, aided by his demicousin Lord Aleksandr IV Harkonnen. Feyd assumed the throne as Emperor Feyd I, founding the House of Feyd, killed all close imperial relations, and suspended the Landsraad. The Corrino heir, the 5 years old Prince Corrin, Wallach II's grandson, was rescued from Feyd's massacre and taken beyond the imperial borders by Paulos II Atreides.
